messages:
Maria (PM): quick question — for the V2 rollout of graceful-degrade, what exact SLO/SLA acceptance criteria do we want for GA? need things we can sign off on in the launch checklist
Ben (Eng): thinking: 99th p50 p95. propose: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 300ms for hosted tier. error rate < 0.5% for successful responses. degrade modes must not drop below 'cached' for >5m
Aj (SRE): add: error budget burn rate alarm at 3x for 10m, and automated rollback if sustained 30m. runbook must include diagnostics: kv-cache hit ratio, batch sizes, model-variant fallback counts
Lina (Product Ops): we also need customer-facing SLA wording. for paid customers can we guarantee p95 < 300ms or we offer credits? what's the bucket for Dedicated customers vs Hosted?
Maria (PM): Dedicated gets stricter SLA + monthly credit policy. Hosted: have a soft SLA for GA (operationally targeted) and then firm SLA after 90d based on telemetry. draft acceptance criteria should reflect that distinction
Ben (Eng): rough acceptance checklist (for reviewers):
```
- Performance: p95 <= 300ms (hosted GA target)
- Stability: <0.5% error rate over 24h window
- Degrade behavior: primary fallback order validated (prefix-cache -> quantized smaller model -> queued-batched responses -> soft 503 with retry hint)
- Observability: tracing + per-route token-level cost + KV hit metrics
- Rollout: canary 5% -> 20% -> 100% with automated rollback on burn rule
- Tests: load test at 3x expected peak, chaos test dropping 20% GPUs
```
Aj (SRE): edge cases to call out: cold-start cold-cache p95 spikes, long-tail seq length regressions (>=4x normal tokens), and degraded model quality alerts — we need eval set coverage and a stopgap fallback to cached best-answer where semantic degradation exceeds threshold
Lina (Product Ops): product question: when we say "cached best-answer" for fallback, customers must be notified in response headers? legal wants explicit flagging for SLA credits and auditing
Ben (Eng): yes add header X-Redwood-Degrade: mode=cache|model|queue, and reason code. will implement. also need schema for reason codes
Maria (PM): acceptance criteria update: include header, audit logs for every degrade event, and customer-visible metrics in console for Dedicated customers
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deployment at 2024-11-05 22:00 UTC for rl-degrade-rollout (5% traffic).
Aj (SRE): I'll own runbook + burn-rate alert wiring. can someone own drafting the SLA language for Hosted vs Dedicated?
Lina (Product Ops): I'll draft customer SLA copy and coordinate legal. aim to have first draft by EOD Thu. :thumbsup:
Ben (Eng): i'll add the header spec + fallback reason codes to the PRD and open the RFC for review
Maria (PM): thanks — let's capture these as acceptance checklist in the PRD and mark items as required vs optional for GA. followups: Ben -> RFC, Lina -> SLA copy, Aj -> runbook. meeting if anyone needs it later this week.
